item.title: College loses its monopoly on the American Dream
item.description: The value of a college diploma is being reconsidered as it loses its status as the sole path to success.

item.title: AI prompts college students to reconsider their majors
item.description: Students and parents are seeking college majors that remain relevant in an AI-driven world, as AI reshapes the skills employers demand.

item.title: Trump dismisses concerns about conditions on USS Abraham Lincoln
item.description: President Trump said Friday he is not worried about the USS Abraham Lincoln's state, despite lawmakers calling for investigations into reported issues.

item.title: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty to stalking and killing UnitedHealthcare CEO
item.description: Luigi Mangione pleaded guilty Friday in federal court to stalking charges related to the 2024 killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson.
